scroll: TAPE 01 [00:12] SUBJECT INTAKE CONFIRMED. Follow the route marks. If the picture skips, do not step into the missing frame.
TAPE 01 [01:05] Doors are provided. Keys are provided. This is not a metaphor.
TAPE 01 [01:58] Some footage of this wing is missing. This is normal. Continue.
TAPE 01 [02:41] DESIGNATION 01 is a recording of a subject who walked the same route until the tape wore through. It still follows the route. Do not greet it.
TAPE 01 [03:30] The ceiling in the east passage was measured incorrectly on purpose. Duck.
TAPE 01 [04:12] Some of the floor was removed during a previous intake. It was not replaced.
TAPE 01 [05:03] DESIGNATION 01 will not deviate from its route. You are permitted to.
TAPE 01 [05:47] Orientation is complete. Tape 02 introduces personnel. Do not skip ahead.
TAPE 01 [07:10] ANOMALY: THE GLITCH. It marks a door, then rushes across your last position twice. Dodge both passes; strike the keyhole after the second crash.
boss_lore: CARPENTRY LOG -- NORTH WING
Elias Venn fitted every door in the north wing. After the flood, he bolted the rooms from outside. Three nights later, the knocks began coming from inside the walls.
INCIDENT 09-B
Venn vanished during the renovation. His apron was found nailed to a door that had no hinges. The crew removed that door. It appeared again in the next room.
UNSIGNED
The first rush is a test. The second follows your new position. After it hits the far frame, the keyhole stays open long enough for one charge.

scroll: TAPE 02 [04:40] DESIGNATION 01 repeats an escape route. It has not learned that the route ends here. Do not interrupt its count.
TAPE 02 [05:22] More than one DESIGNATION 01 has been logged in this hallway. They do not acknowledge each other. Neither should you.
TAPE 02 [06:10] DESIGNATION 01 has been observed on elevated surfaces. The floor was never guaranteed to be safer.
TAPE 02 [09:03] DESIGNATION 02 forms where the signal loses a frame. A rising whine means it is choosing a place to fall. Move clear before the break.
TAPE 02 [09:51] DESIGNATION 02 dives toward the last place it recorded you. The red tearing is the warning. Keep moving after it commits.
TAPE 02 [10:36] Two instances of DESIGNATION 02 have been recorded moving out of sync with each other. This has not been explained.
TAPE 02 [11:20] DESIGNATION 01 and 02 share this corridor. During an Auditor scan, enter the gap; neither creature can follow you between frames.
TAPE 02 [12:08] The dust in this hallway was tested. The results were not released to new intake.
TAPE 02 [12:59] Some doors here are monitored from the other side. This is for your protection. We will not say whose.
TAPE 02 [13:44] Intake is complete. Your file has been updated. Tape 03 was recorded below ground level.
TAPE 03 [15:40] ANOMALY: THE SIGNAL. Shelter at either wall while the bright stripe sweeps the center. When the projector stops and its lens turns pale, touch it.
boss_lore: PROJECTION BOOTH LOG

Mara Doss was assigned to restore the manor fire-drill reel. Every repaired copy showed the booth eleven seconds later than the last. Mara stopped appearing in the room, but kept appearing on the film.
REEL 09 -- FRAME 288
The figure on screen is standing behind the camera. The camera is bolted to the booth wall. There is no door behind it.
MARGIN NOTE
The beam is not burning the room. It is exposing the next frame over this one. When the feed runs out, the lens has to cool. That is the only time it can see you.

scroll: TAPE 03 [15:21] DESIGNATION 03 is a subject who stopped moving so completely that the recording filed them as furniture. Proximity wakes the body. Distance is your only warning.
TAPE 03 [19:48] DESIGNATION 04 records the room and sends its image back to the building. When it turns toward you, it has already made a copy of your position.
TAPE 03 [21:02] DESIGNATION 03 responds to proximity, not to sound, not to light. Distance is the only known deterrent.
TAPE 03 [21:55] DESIGNATION 03 moves slower than an average intake subject. When the Auditor begins its red sweep, stillness inside a footage gap is the only safe answer.
TAPE 03 [22:40] Two units of DESIGNATION 04 have overlapping fields of view. There is no angle that is watched by neither.
TAPE 03 [23:31] DESIGNATION 01 is not aware DESIGNATION 03 has been activated in this sector. DESIGNATION 03 does not care either way.
TAPE 03 [24:15] A DESIGNATION 01 unit and a DESIGNATION 04 unit have been placed in the same corridor deliberately. Study the DESIGNATION 01's timing. The 04 cannot be reasoned with.
TAPE 03 [25:09] Once DESIGNATION 03 activates, DESIGNATION 04 will not pause its recording to let it pass. Elevated surfaces are recommended for both.
TAPE 03 [26:20] DESIGNATION 03 was logged under a name before it was assigned a number. The name has been removed from this file. Please do not ask for it.
TAPE 03 [27:02] (a second voice, underneath) -- they didn't take me. I walked down here myself. I want that on the record.
TAPE 03 [29:40] ANOMALY: THE COUNSEL. Jump clear of the red court seal before the gavel falls. Every third ruling, dodge her three-paper volley. Touch her while she recovers.
boss_lore: COURT TRANSCRIPT -- CASE 13
Ada Mercer defended the residents the manor erased from its records. Her final case had no client, no judge, and no exit from the courtroom.
OBJECTION OVERRULED
Mercer died at the bench while appealing the manor's verdict. Her next argument appeared in the transcript the following morning, in handwriting no one recognized.
BAILIFF'S NOTE
A red seal marks where the accused stood. The gavel hits that spot after the warning. Jump clear, then approach while the Counsel catches her breath.

scroll: TAPE 04 [22:47] This floor is assembled from rooms removed from earlier tapes. The gaps are real. The doors are copied. Your route has been filed before you walk it.
TAPE 04 [22:12] All four Designations have been logged active in this sector simultaneously. This has never happened before. It is happening now.
TAPE 04 [22:50] The lamp in this room flickers on a fixed interval. The interval matches something. We have not said what.
TAPE 04 [21:38] Recessed alcoves along this corridor are outside both units' recorded range. Use them. Do not linger in them.
TAPE 04 [21:38] The image has narrow gaps where the recorder failed to agree with itself. Step into one when the Auditor announces a scan. Stay still until the sweep passes.
TAPE 04 [19:59] [TIMECODE ERROR] -- someone is narrating faster now. I don't think there's much tape left. I don't think that's about the tape.
TAPE 04 [23:44] If the corridor below you is silent, that is not a good sign. DESIGNATION 02 does not make noise until it is close.
TAPE 04 [20:14] The sound underneath this recording is not the building. Please continue as though it is the building.
TAPE 04 [24:03] [TIMECODE ERROR] You flinch at footsteps I cannot hear on this side of the tape. A door opens that was not on the floor plan.
TAPE 04 [19:33] There is no marked exit from this floor. There is only the next room. The doors are copied from routes taken by earlier subjects.
TAPE 04 [24:59] Unlisted Floor documentation is complete. Do not file a report. Tape 05 is the last approved recording.
TAPE 04 [26:50] ANOMALY: THE GATE. Watch for the raised crown. Jump over the shockwave after its slam, then stomp the open crown. At two plates, it slams twice.
boss_lore: NIGHT GATE SHIFT BOOK
Hollis Reed guarded the sealed west exit. His notes list every person turned away, though the exit had been bricked up before he took the job.
INCIDENT REPORT -- 4TH KNOCK
The Gate raised its crown, then struck the floor hard enough to send a shockwave across the corridor. Its crown opened after the impact.
ENGINEERING MARGIN
The latch is inside the shell. Jump the shockwave and stomp the open crown. With two plates left, the Gate slams twice before it stays open.
RESERVE LATCH -- DO NOT TEST
The reserve spring loads after the first impact. The second slam sends a faster shockwave; jump again, then reach the open crown.

scroll: TAPE 05 [--:--] Please remain calm. Please remain exactly where you are. We are almost finished here.
TAPE 05 [--:--] The voices on this tape belong to subjects who chose STAY. They are not guiding you out. They are trying to keep you company in the room where they remained.
TAPE 05 [--:--] DESIGNATION 05 is not a fifth subject. It is the recording trying to reproduce you from incomplete evidence. During an Auditor scan, hide in the gap and let the copy pass.
TAPE 05 [--:--] [TIMECODE ERROR] I am not the only one in this building holding on past the point I should have stopped.

TAPE 05 [--:--] Designations 01 through 04 are not separate species. Each preserves one response from an earlier subject: flee, fall, freeze, watch. The Program separated them so you would think they were alone.
TAPE 05 [--:--] Beneath the recording is a steady sound. It is not a machine in the house. It is the monitor of the subject whose memories the Program has been using.
TAPE 05 [--:--] The Auditor is the building checking whether its copy matches the living subject. The red scan is the warning. The footage gap is the only place it cannot verify.
TAPE 05 [--:--] It is permitted to be tired. Everyone who is waiting for you already knows that, somewhere, in a much quieter room.
TAPE 05 [--:--] The Warden is the sum of every attempt to leave, including the ones the record says never happened. There is no guidance for what happens next. Proceed anyway.
TAPE 05 [--:--] ANOMALY: THE RECORD. Avoid its shots. When it chases you and its core opens, strike it. The arena will lose platforms as the fight continues.
boss_lore: LEDGER OFFICE -- FINAL ENTRY
Nell Rusk recorded each test subject as RECOVERED or NOT RECOVERED. She never used names. On the last page, someone had written her name under both columns.
CARBON COPY 53
Rusk died before the final test. The next morning her handwriting appeared in the ledger again. Each new line was a different hand, but all of them wrote the same room number.
UNSIGNED -- DO NOT FILE
The Record is not a guard. It is the act of counting what the house failed to keep. Every time it says your number, another old attempt moves inside its coat.
